issues.description:
Method return-type contradiction for getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents():
- In problem_statement.md (UML) the method is declared as returning void (line 71: "+getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): void").
- In the textual task description in problem_statement.md the method is described as returning a String (lines 43-45: "returns a String of the following format LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)").
- The reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java defines the method as public String getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() (signature on line 80).
This inconsistency can mislead students: following the UML (void) would produce a different signature than the solution/tests expect (String), causing compile-time or test failures and confusion about the correct API to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferred: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare the method as returning String (change the UML line to "+getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String"). Ensure the textual description and example remain unchanged and note the expected return type in the task wording so students and tests align.
